summary: Iter121 (backend + frontend, public URL, mobile 390x844). Everything requested PASSES. Backend (new file test_kiosk_total_due_invalidate_iter121.py, 3/3 PASS): (1) For all 5 demo tenants, GET /api/kiosk/tenants/{id}/overview returns total_due == round(open_invoices_total + current_invoices_total, 2) and a boolean is_paid == (total_due <= 0.005). Jan has total_due 18000 while balance.balance is 6000, and Marlies/Anisha have negative balances with total_due 0. (2) For 3 tenants, /api/tenant-portal/overview total_due and is_paid match the kiosk overview. (3) The 30s list cache was warmed and an employee WS was connected. Then admin POST /api/payments for Roy (HUIS 2C, 3000 open) -> the WS received {type:'overview_invalidate', tenant_id: Roy}. Right after, the kiosk overview showed total_due 0 / is_paid true, and /kiosk/apartments pay_status went partial -> paid (no stale cache). Frontend employee kiosk (PIN 4321): with the HUIS 2C overview open, a payment registered via the admin API changed overview-total from SRD 3.000,00 to SRD 0,00 within 0.5s, with no user action ('Alles voldaan' shown). Tenant kiosk (/kiosk/huurder): Jan (total_due 18000, balance 6000) shows tk-balance and tk-total-due as SRD 18.000,00, the 'Openstaande huur' card and 'U heeft een openstaand bedrag.', and Mijn gegevens Saldo = SRD 18.000,00. Kevin was seeded temporarily with balance.balance 13500 and total_due 0 (tenant created_at moved back to 2026-07-01). He shows as paid: SRD 0,00 in green, no 'Openstaande huur' card, 'U bent volledig bij. Bedankt!', and Mijn gegevens Saldo is SRD 0,00 in green. So the UI never falls back to balance.balance. Cleanup is done: test payments were deleted with also_delete_invoices=false, Kevin's created_at was restored, the DB has 0 TEST_iter121 payments, and all totals are back to their original values.

minor.issue: Only create_payment calls _kiosk_overview_invalidate. The other payment mutations clear the server cache (live-sync middleware) but send no WS overview_invalidate. An open employee-kiosk overview stays stale after an admin deletes or approves a payment. This was observed: after the cleanup DELETE, the open overview stayed at SRD 0,00 until it was reopened.

pay_status counts every invoice with status != 'paid', including future invoices (no due-date or bucket filter). A tenant who only has future invoices would show 'unpaid'/'partial' in the kiosk list while the overview says is_paid=true. The list should use the same open+current rule as total_due.

issues: After full payment, the left panel shows one row 'Maandhuur SRD 0,00', which can read as if the rent is 0. Consider showing the real rent amount, or 'Huidige maand voldaan'.

action_items: Optional: call _kiosk_overview_invalidate(cid, tenant_id) in delete_payment, approve/reject payment, reassign-invoice and invoice mutations as well, so open kiosk overviews refresh live.
Optional: align the /kiosk/apartments pay_status rule with total_due/is_paid (ignore future invoices).
critical_code_review_comments: tenant_portal_overview calls the full kiosk_tenant_overview and then recomputes fines with its own, different loop. Use kov['fines_total'] / kov['fines_currency'] instead. That removes the duplicated logic and the risk of two different fine amounts.
_KIOSK_CACHE/_INVOICE_CACHE are in-process dicts. With more than one uvicorn worker, clear() only affects the worker that handled the POST. It is fine for the current single worker.
server.py is over 11k lines and should be split into modules.
